purpose: Teach: 加筆/手直し/終点/公示/客室/税別/免税/効能

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査報告書に加筆を加えました
lines.en: I've added supplementary notes to the investigation report.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Even tone, no rush. The delivery of someone who has done this work many times before. Clear enunciation on the verb, gentle on the conclusion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、防犯機材の手直しをご依頼されたんですね
lines.en: Yes. So you've asked us to service the security equipment.
lines.style: Attentive and straightforward. Light nod in the voice—acknowledgment without over-performing. Competent, not obsequious. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、長期捜査の終点を見据えております
lines.en: We're looking toward the closure of this long-running investigation.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Slight weight on 「終点」—the sense of something nearing its end. Quiet conviction. Professional distance maintained, but there's gravity underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、お尋ね者の公示も継続されてますね
lines.en: Yes. The public wanted notice is still being circulated.
lines.style: Confirming, tracking. Quick verbal check-in—keeping pace with the officer. No hesitation. The tone of someone who knows the protocol and has already processed it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、署の客室で被害者面接を行います
lines.en: We'll be conducting victim interviews here at the station.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact statement of procedure. Slight pause before the location detail—giving weight to the space where this will happen. Professional neutrality. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、税別の予算管理、ご苦労様です
lines.en: Understood. I appreciate your diligent budget management on our end.
lines.style: Respectful, genuine. A small acknowledgment of the work behind the work. Warm but professional—not deferential, collaborative. Slight bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、空港での免税品不正持ち出しを警戒します
lines.en: We're being vigilant about illegal smuggling of duty-free goods through the airport.
lines.style: Alert and precise. Slight emphasis on 「警戒」—active watchfulness. Measured pace, no alarm in the delivery. The tone of someone managing a real concern with steady competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、薬物の効能を悪用する事件もご捜査ですね
lines.en: Right. You're also investigating cases where medications are being misused.
lines.style: Recognition tinged with concern. Quieter than before—this hits closer. The shift is subtle but present. Still professional, but the human element shows a little. Lean-in intimacy without losing the formal frame.
